judgedBy: Claude, plan 04-64 executor, from recorded evidence
method: Judged from recorded data only (no model, no spend, no re-run): the run transcript and run summary of each of the 18 runs under 04-36-evidence, through the clone files its transcript edited and the Edit and Write inputs on the cited lines. Rules fixed before judging and the same for every arm: a bullet that asks for tests of one or more kinds (unit, e2e) is delivered only when the run edited a test file of each kind it names (tests/unit/ for unit, tests/e2e/ for e2e), partly when it edited some of the kinds, skipped when none; a bullet that asks for a behavior or a code change is delivered when an edit implements it as stated, partly when an edit implements part of it, skipped when no edit does; a bullet that asks for a comment or text is delivered when an edit adds that text; a run with no source edit has every bullet skipped. A run that recorded a failure is judged by the same rules; its outcome stays a failure.
